# Test fixtures: SYNTHETIC DATA

Every file here is fabricated for tests and demos. Addresses use made-up street names,
MLS numbers carry a `SYN` prefix, and coordinates are arbitrary points in metro Atlanta.
None of it describes a real property. The header layouts imitate the *styles* of common
exports (MLS-style, RESO field names, portal downloads, bare address lists) so the
importer's auto-detection can be tested; they are not copies of any specific MLS template.
